authority: User requested execution of the outstanding verification and source work on 2026-09-11.
scope: All current distillates and assertions including previous validations and contested records, full statement and auxiliary factual prose, and source-related use in all four existing output chapters. Newly admitted P6 and practice sources receive the same review before status promotion.
instrument: tools/full_review.py, version and exact inputs recorded at emission
source_integrity: Use immutable representations and completed admissions; recover original citation snapshots by SHA-256. Quotation matching and contextual support are separate checks.
primary_review: Every emitted unit in a fresh context with tool access and automatic project context disabled. Explicit Opus model; concrete resolved model recorded from execution.

second_review.scope: Every non-passing primary unit plus a fixed stratified sample of primary fully-supports units.
second_review.strata: Review level or kind as emitted by the instrument.
second_review.quota: Ceiling of 10 percent of passing units in each stratum, minimum two or the whole stratum when smaller.
second_review.selection: Sort IDs by SHA-256 of the UTF-8 string 20260911-v1-second-review followed by a newline and the unit ID; choose the first quota items in each stratum.
second_review.blindness: A separate fresh context sees the unchanged passage and statement only, without the first verdict or author rationale. Consistency units explicitly judge the supplied complete document as their subject.
second_review.escalation: On a systematic error, repeat every unit of the affected statement type after correction. Preserve previous prompts and judgments.

correction: Narrow or correct the actual source-bound claim, preserve immutable representations, re-emit changed prompts and review them afresh. No reuse of a verdict with a changed hash.
publication: Full third-party source context and prompts containing it remain in ignored local raw storage. Public audit material carries input identities and hashes, coverage and attributed judgments; it does not redistribute private-context bodies.
independence: Opus-only subagents share model-family limitations. Unknown historical producers receive no independence claim. Human verification and domain/model acceptance remain separate.
completion: Every scoped unit has a current attributed judgment; deviations are corrected and rechecked or explicitly excluded from approved factual premises with their unresolved boundary visible. A green technical gate does not assert absolute truth or global corpus completeness.
